rows.note: Use 表達 as the all-purpose choice for conveying an impression, feeling, or idea.

example.english: This painting can really convey that sense of loneliness.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫好好咁表達到嗰種孤獨感。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 waa6 hou2 hou2 gam2 biu2 daat6 dou2 go2 zung2 gu1 duk6 gam2

rows.note: Use 傳達 when passing information, a message, or a meaning on to someone.

example.english: Please convey the message to Ming for me.
example.traditional: 麻煩你將個口信傳達畀阿明。
example.jyutping: maa4 faan4 nei5 zoeng1 go3 hau2 seon3 cyun4 daat6 bei2 aa3 ming4

rows.note: Use 傳送 when something such as sound, data, or a signal is transmitted from one place to another.

example.english: The network will convey the signal to headquarters.
example.traditional: 個訊號會經網絡傳送到總部。
example.jyutping: go3 seon3 hou6 wui5 ging1 mong5 lok3 cyun4 sung3 dou3 zung2 bou6

rows.note: Use 運送 for physically transporting an object, substance, or load from one place to another.

example.english: The truck will convey this shipment to the New Territories tomorrow.
example.traditional: 架貨車聽日會運送呢批貨去新界。
example.jyutping: gaa3 fo3 ce1 ting1 jat6 wui5 wan6 sung3 ni1 pai1 fo3 heoi3 san1 gaai3
